Question: With \(400\) members voting, the House of Representatives defeated a bill. A re-vote, with the same members voting, resulted in passage of the bill by twice the margin by which it was originally defeated. The number voting for the bill on the re-vote was \(\dfrac{12}{11}\) of the number voting against it originally. How many more members voted for the bill the second time than voted for it the first time?
